title: Audit the concrete root rather than a convenient wrapper
obstacle: Local modules compile but the accepted root has stronger premises or a weaker conclusion.
procedure: Compare the full root signature to the frozen mathematical target.
Expand structure, implicit and proposition-valued parameters.
Derive missing root prerequisites internally and assemble the intended concrete theorem.
verification: Print actual signature/axioms and map every retained non-library premise to the original ledger.
positive_example: BO removes an extra datum-specific L2 input from the final weighted theorem.
negative_example: A theorem conditional on an arbitrary profile bound is not the original central-universality theorem.
version_boundary: Pattern observed in these pinned sources; exact APIs must be checked at application.

## Final target re-audit (2026-08-24)

The preceding historical progress text is superseded for frozen target P by
this incremental re-audit. The earliest changed descendants were the S
high/low splice and P5; their downstream target is
`exists_global_ball_maximal_theorem_P` in `FinalMaximalAssembly.lean`.

Its explicit parameters are exactly `d : Nat`, `0 < d`, a concrete lattice
function `f`, and `latticeMemL2 d f`; its conclusion is a single strictly
positive real constant uniform in both `d` and `f`, bounding the concrete
integer-layer `ballMaxL2Norm`. There is no predicate-valued hypothesis,
typeclass field, opaque project input, or weakened essential-supremum target.
The real-radius convention remains connected by `radiusBall_eq_ball_floor`
and `radiusBall_sqrt_nat`.

8787 jobs. `lake build EuclideanBallsFormalization.AxiomAudit` completed all
8788 jobs. The focused command
`lake env lean EuclideanBallsFormalization/FinalAxiomAudit.lean` reported:

```text
P: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound,
   external_fjk_theta_estimate, external_gaussian_maximal,
   external_jacobi_product, external_large_radius_ball_maximal.
```
